text: Hi! Do you sell coffee grinders that can do espresso?
Yes, the Coffee Grinder Pro has 30 settings, including espresso.
Nice. Is it loud?
It's about as loud as a hair dryer for a few seconds.
Haha ok. And does the kettle come in black?
Yes, the Kettle comes in white and black.
Can I pay with a gift card and a credit card together?
Yes, you can split the payment between one gift card and one card.
Thanks! By the way your website is really slow today.
Sorry about that, our team is looking into it.
Do you have any discount codes?
Not right now, but you can subscribe to our newsletter for future offers.
Ok never mind. What's your return policy for kettles?
You can return unused items within 30 days.
Great, I just placed my order.
Thank you, Mina! You will get an email when it ships.
Quick update: I moved last weekend! My new address is 7 Lake Road. Please send everything there from now on.
Thanks, I have noted your new address in your customer profile.
Also, can I get the kettle gift-wrapped?
Sorry, gift wrapping is only possible before an order ships.
No problem. Do you have descaling tablets for the kettle?
Yes, we sell a pack of 12 for €6.
Maybe next time. Is it normal that the tracking hasn't changed for days?
Sometimes parcels wait at a hub. Let me know if nothing changes.
Ok, thanks.
